claims.statement: Joe Wormald wrote to Tom Allen asking him to arrange the preliminaries of a match with Ned O'Baldwin for $5,000 a side.
claims.excerpt: received s letter from Joe Wurmald, requesting yp te arrange the preliminaries of a mill with Ned

notes: Text is cut off after 'the fight to take place in', so the venue (Canada in the hint) is not supported and was dropped. The letter was received 'yesterday' in a paper dated Aug 21, so Aug 20.
